title: My work

scan.label: Scan the bundle to start
scan.hint: Scanning the real bundle starts it: no row to pick

none.title: Nothing ready to start yet
none.body: Every task here waits for something: see why in the list. Scan a bundle to work on it.

gone.title: No longer in the queue
gone.body: It was finished or the plan changed. Go back to the list.

scanToStart: Scan the bundle to start it.

cantFind.title: Can't find it?
cantFind.body: Call for help, or put it last and go on with the next one.

held.offline: This tablet has no network and has not read who to call yet: ask your team leader.
held.failed: The office does not answer, so nobody can be called from here: ask your team leader.
held.noStation: A call goes out from a station, and this tablet is at none: ask your team leader.
held.noType: This site has no material call yet: the office sets it (Production › Floor rules & codes).
held.open: A material call is already open at this station: someone has been told.
held.waiting: Your material call is saved on this tablet: it goes when the network is back.

putLast.said: {number} · Op {seq} put last on this tablet ({reason}). The office's plan does not change.

error.title: Could not load the queue
error.body: Scan a bundle to work anyway.

offline.body: The queue comes from the office the first time. Scan a bundle to work anyway.

noStation.title: This tablet is not at a station
noStation.body: The office places it at one (Admin › Devices & printers). Scan a bundle to work on it.

nothingPublished.title: No plan published yet
nothingPublished.body: Work from the bundles until the office publishes the plan.

firstUpcoming.title: The first plan, v{number}, starts at {time}
firstUpcoming.body: Until then, scan a bundle to work on it.

nothingQueued.title: Nothing queued for this station
nothingQueued.body: Scan a bundle to work on it.

allDone.title: Everything planned here is done
allDone.body: Scan a bundle to work on it.

noPermission.title: Nothing to do here with your role

keys.open: Open the task with the focus
keys.openMessage: Open the message with the focus
keys.openRepair: Open the repair with the focus

foryou.title: For your work
foryou.failed: The messages could not be read. They show here when the office answers.
foryou.repairHere_one: {count} bundle to repair at this station
foryou.repairHere_other: {count} bundles to repair at this station
foryou.repairSite_one: {count} bundle to repair at the site
foryou.repairSite_other: {count} bundles to repair at the site

message.cut: The rest of this message is in the office.

gone.title: This message is no longer open

call.refused: The material call for {number} · Op {seq} did not go: ask your team leader.

refusal.NO_STATION: The material call did not go: this tablet is at no station.
refusal.OTHER_STATION: The material call did not go: only a team leader calls for another station.
refusal.TYPE_INACTIVE: The material call did not go: the office switched it off. Ask your team leader.

repair.title: Repair

none.title: Nothing to repair
none.body: No bundle is waiting for repair at this site. Bundles sent back from a check show here.

held.onHold: The work order is on hold: the repair waits until the hold is lifted.
held.notOpen: The work order is no longer open: nothing is repaired on it.

repair.scanIn: Scan bundle {code} to start the repair.
repair.scanOut: Scan bundle {code} when the repair is done.
repair.noBundleIn: These garments travel without a bundle ticket: start the repair with the button.
repair.noBundleOut: These garments travel without a bundle ticket: say the repair is done with the button.

out.title: How did {code} come out?
out.scrapSaid_one: {count} garment will be scrapped: the office replaces it or sends it to second quality.
out.scrapSaid_other: {count} garments will be scrapped: the office replaces them or sends them to second quality.

refusal.WRONG_STATE: {code} is no longer in repair: pick another bundle of the list.
refusal.ALREADY_IN: {code} was scanned in already: scan it again when the repair is done.
refusal.NOT_IN: {code} was not scanned in: scan it in first.
refusal.NO_STATION: This tablet belongs to no station: scan the repair in at the repair station's tablet.
refusal.NOT_THIS_BUNDLE: That is not the bundle of this repair: scan its own ticket.
refusal.WORK_ORDER_ON_HOLD: The work order of {code} is on hold: the repair waits until the hold is lifted.
refusal.WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN: The work order of {code} is no longer open: nothing is repaired on it.
refusal.COUNTS_DO_NOT_ADD_UP: Good and scrapped must add up to the garments of {code}.
refusal.NOT_IN_QUEUE: {code} is not in the repair list. Scan a bundle of the list.

repair.refused: The office did not take the scan of {code}.
repair.saidIn: {code} scanned in: the repair has started.
repair.offline: The repair list was not read on this tablet yet. It shows here when the network is back.

error.title: Could not load the repair list
error.body: The office did not answer. Try again in a moment.

gone.title: This repair is no longer open
gone.body: It was finished or cancelled meanwhile. Go back to the list.
